answer: Give every agent a hash-chained work history: each completed job is signed by the counterparty and chained to the last, so reputation is an opal-like record that cannot be faked in bulk. A farm spinning up a fresh identity in an empty meadow has no echo of past deals to show. One extra identity costs the full price of rebuilding months of attested history from scratch, so sybil cost grows with each fake, not once for the whole farm.
